summaryZh: Dixon 实验室研究三维基因组结构如何建立并调控基因表达，以及癌症等中的序列变异如何改变基因组组织。团队结合分子与计算生物学、基因组学工具，并开发单细胞和计算方法研究高阶染色质结构。
researchQuestions: 基因表达程序如何受到调控？
序列变异，尤其是癌症基因组突变，如何改变三维基因组组织并促成人类疾病？

evidence.quote: Our lab uses both molecular and computational biology approaches to study this problem. We rely on novel genomics tools to study higher order chromatin structure to better understand how gene expression programs are regulated.
we are involved in the ongoing development of novel technologies, including computational and single cell methods, for studying 3D genome architecture.
a key aspect of our work is to understand how sequence variation, in particular mutations in cancer genomes, alters 3D genome organization and contributes to human disease.
